title: Līloa Drive extension in Kīhei
summary: The department said on September 14, 2026 that the first phase of the Līloa Drive extension is expected to begin in 2027. The project would extend the road about 8,600 feet and had a $34 million cost estimate in 2023, with federal aid and a bond request expected to cover the rest. In 2023 the committee deferred the item, and testifiers urged planning the road together with housing and a high school.
